title: Rent a brain or own one? (EP34: open vs closed models)
label: EP34
banner: Rent a brain or own one?

lines.text: AI! Customers waiting and you've gone SILENT?!
lines.show: AI! Customers waiting and you've gone SILENT?!
lines.tts: AI! Customers waiting and you've gone silent?!

lines.text: No internet. You rent me, anna. My brain isn't here.
lines.show: No internet. You rent me, anna. My brain isn't here.

lines.text: Rent?! I rented this shop twenty years, then I bought it!
lines.show: Rent?! I rented this shop twenty years, then I bought it!

lines.text: My brain sits on a company's computers. [1] Every order you type goes to them. [2] Closed model: you pay per question.
lines.show: My brain sits on a company's computers. Every order you type goes to them. Closed model: you pay per question.

lines.text: Then I'll buy my own brain!
lines.show: Then I'll buy my own brain!

lines.text: Some companies give theirs away: open models. [1] Even ChatGPT's maker. [2] Just not ChatGPT.
lines.show: Some companies give theirs away: open models. Even ChatGPT's maker. Just not ChatGPT.

lines.text: What, free?!
lines.show: What, free?!

lines.text: The brain is free. [1] The skull is sold separately.
lines.show: The brain is free. The skull is sold separately.

lines.text: Arey, can a free brain make my bills?
lines.show: Arey, can a free brain make my bills?

lines.text: We tested three free ones. [1] Twenty WhatsApp orders, internet off, a plain computer.
lines.show: We tested three free ones. Twenty WhatsApp orders, internet off, a plain computer.

lines.text: Twenty! It's a computer!
lines.show: Twenty! It's a computer!

lines.text: One gigabyte: one right. [1] Three gigabytes: nine. [2] It added tomatoes nobody ordered.
lines.show: One gigabyte: one right. Three gigabytes: nine. It added tomatoes nobody ordered.

lines.text: And the bigger one?
lines.show: And the bigger one?

lines.text: Five gigabytes: [1] eighteen.
lines.show: Five gigabytes: eighteen.

lines.text: Two wrong bills?!
lines.show: Two wrong bills?!

lines.text: One bill: five sixty-six for a two thirty-one order. [1] And ten customers wait two and a half minutes.
lines.show: One bill: five sixty-six for a two thirty-one order. And ten customers wait two and a half minutes.
lines.tts: One bill: five sixty six, for a two thirty one order. And ten customers wait two and a half minutes.

lines.text: Then you come into my laptop.
lines.show: Then you come into my laptop.

lines.text: Rented brains don't do home delivery.
lines.show: Rented brains don't do home delivery.

lines.text: So which one do I use?!
lines.show: So which one do I use?!

lines.text: Rent: needs internet, pay per question. [1] Own: works offline, your data stays home, you buy the computer.
lines.show: Rent: needs internet, pay per question. Own: works offline, your data stays home, you buy the computer.

lines.text: Your bills? Rent, and test it on the same twenty. [1] Net down? Calculator.
lines.show: Your bills? Rent, and test it on the same twenty. Net down? Calculator.

lines.text: I don't RENT! I'll own the biggest free brain!
lines.show: I don't RENT! I'll own the biggest free brain!
lines.tts: I don't rent! I'll own the biggest free brain!

lines.text: The big ones run on a twenty-five-lakh graphics card.
lines.show: The big ones run on a twenty-five-lakh graphics card.
lines.tts: The big ones run on a twenty five lakh graphics card.

lines.text: Then I'll rent a big computer.
lines.show: Then I'll rent a big computer.

lines.text: So... renting again.
lines.show: So... renting again.
